401-3944-5931-8125.easyPrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-3944-5931-8125.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Davvol triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Funeral Room trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

222-527-6495-8201.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-6495-8201.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
222-527-6495-8201.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

240-1753-5470-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
240-1753-5470-8227.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

1339-1940-2511.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-1940-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

539-728-3249-6112--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
539-728-3249-6112--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Ashaya by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Fumulus triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1170-2350-4779-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2350-4779-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Stone Calendar.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing the artifact, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn
Repeat.

2511-3147-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Azorius Chancery.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Azorius Chancery from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Azorius Chancery enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

1115-1409-3099-4289.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3755-5434-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
3755-5434-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
3755-5434-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

3532-5078-6289-7737.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it's attached to
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2315-3946-7705.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

2034-4460-5477-5660-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the tapped Plant, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

333-997-7424.notablePrerequisites: Changing Loyalty attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-997-7424.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2653-5702-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1270-2653-5702-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create three token copies of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the first Mutable Explorer trigger, creating a Mutavault land token that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault token enters, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 4 for the second trigger.
Repeat from step 4 for the third trigger, instead choosing to pay for Springheart Nantuko's trigger to create three token copies of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

198-236-1978.description:
Animate Empowered Autogenerator using Bring to Life.
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {1} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat from step 2.
198-236-1978.notes: The combo assumes Empowered Autogenerator has no charge counters on it when you start. If it has charge counters, the mana cost is reduced by {1}.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

620-3693-6712.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that has indestructible and either flash or haste.
620-3693-6712.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to the creature with indestructible.
Sonic's second ability triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Yotian Dissident triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Repeat.

813-4428-6103-6492.description:
Cast Illusion of Choice by paying {U}, allowing you to decide how each player votes this turn and causing you to draw a a card.
Cast Plea for Power by paying {3}{U}, choosing all votes to be for time, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Illusion of Choice and Plea for Power from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

147-5686-6476.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{R} plus enough mana and/or cards in your graveyard to cast Afterlife from the Loam
147-5686-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Afterlife from the Loam.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Afterlife from the Loam, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Afterlife from the Loam, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1202-1737-2981-4853.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Myr Moonvessel.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, Myr Moonvessel and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Myr Moonvessel trigger, adding {C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Megatog ability, giving it +3/+3 and trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

requires.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blcoked and killed by an opponent

2079-3259--95.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and the creature with mobilize as attackers, triggering the creature with mobilize, creating at least one 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Warrior token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
2079-3259--95.notes: If you choose a creature with mobilize 2 or higher, this combo makes extra Warrior tokens each loop.

4053-5231--73.notablePrerequisites: If a persist creature is used, it does not have a -1/-1 counter on it. Otherwise, if an undying creature is used, it does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
4053-5231--73.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist or undying creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, its persist or undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter or a +1/+1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

2557-3334-3484-5391.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
2557-3334-3484-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

2538-3652-3676-6193.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Tangleroot triggers, adding {G}.
When Ornithopter enters the battlefield, Soul of the Harvest triggers.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you draw.
Resolve the Soul of the Harvest trigger, causing you to return Ornithopter from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1525-2031-2406-2660-3388.notablePrerequisites:
Moritte of the Frost is a copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
1525-2031-2406-2660-3388.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
1525-2031-2406-2660-3388.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

373-877-3967-4484.notablePrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
"Zombie" chosen with Morophon.
373-877-3967-4484.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Ebondeath, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

457-1409-3169.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Urza.
457-1409-3169.description:
Activate Urza by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Urza enters the battlefield, it, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Genesis Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Urza trigger, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Urza.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping the Myr and Construct, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

1017-1656-3795-4762.notablePrerequisites:
Wizard Class is level three.
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one Ally.
1017-1656-3795-4762.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Sea Gate Loremaster's ability by tapping it, causing you to draw at least one card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Necrotic Ooze.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

262-567-859.notablePrerequisites:
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
Elemental Mastery attached to Lurking Roper.
262-567-859.description:
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, creating four 1/1 Elemental creature tokens.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield, they trigger Soul's Attendant four times.
Resolve the first Soul's Attendant trigger, causing you to gain one life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

77-2618-4399-4978.description:
Activate Faith Healer by sacrificing Spirit Loop.
Spirit Loop triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Faith Healer ability, causing you to gain two life.
Cast Spirit Loop by paying two life, targeting any creature.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat.

2003-3609-4353.notablePrerequisites: Magistrate's Scepter has at least one charge counter on it.
2003-3609-4353.description:
Activate Contagion Engine by paying {4} and tapping it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
At the beginning of your end step, Atraxa triggers, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1778-4763-4955-5147.description:
Equip Memnite with Grafted Wargear.
Sacrifice Memnite to Goblin Bombardment to deal 1 damage to any target.
Koll triggers, returning Memnite to you hand.
Cast Memnite.
Repeat.

144-1636-4319-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Ashcloud Phoenix.
Ashcloud Phoenix triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield face down.
Ashcloud Phoenix enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning Ashcloud Phoenix face up.
Repeat.

3525-3756-4348.notablePrerequisites:
Ley Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Ley Druid.
3525-3756-4348.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Ley Druid.
Repeat any number of times.

364-1964-1987-2556.description:
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.
